title: GovRoute Record Schema v0.1.0
_doctrine: I1  No record may contain an eligibility determination. Records describe services, not users.
I2  No routing answer may be rendered without a resolvable record id. Enforced at query time.
I3  display_state is DERIVED from verification, never authored. A record cannot claim to be current.
I4  Escalation records are not retrievable by the routing model. Deterministic match only.
I5  Every destination change is a new revision with a changelog entry. Records are append-only.

id.description: namespaced and stable: ssa.card-replace. Never reused, never renamed.

name.description: Imperative, plain. 'Replace a Social Security card' not 'Card Replacement Services'.

aliases.description: Vernacular. This is what retrieval actually keys on -- weight it heavily. Include misspellings, Spanish, and the phrasing people use when distressed.

plain_summary.description: <=25 words. Describes the SERVICE. Linted against eligibility language (I1) and reading level.

authority.description: USC or CFR citation. If present it is WATCHED via the Federal Register API -- amendment triggers review.

display_state.description: DERIVED (I3). Authoring this field is a lint failure.

disclosure.description: Renders the leaving-the-site interstitial. CURATED, never generated (I2). This text is your speech -- it is the single most legally load-bearing field in the schema.

why.description: One sentence, factual, no determination. 'The SSA issues and replaces Social Security cards.' NOT 'you can replace yours online.'

official.description: false for federally-mandated private destinations like annualcreditreport.com

free.description: Whether the government service itself is free. Surfaced prominently -- this is the anti-fraud affordance.

allow_redirect_to.description: Known-good redirect targets. Anything else = drift.

fingerprint.description: Selector-scoped, NOT whole-page. Whole-page hashing false-positives on every nav change.

selector.description: CSS selector for the operative content region

cost.description: Stated fact, e.g. '$130 as of 2026-08'. Dated, because fees change.

oneOf.title: handoff
oneOf.description: Federal frame, non-federal administration. The single most common structural case and the one most likely to be answered wrong by a naive router.

subtype.description: PREFER federal_locator. Route to the federal router that already maintains the 50-state table -- DOL for UI, FNS for SNAP, vote.gov for registration. Use own_table only where no federal locator exists; each jurisdiction row is a separate maintenance obligation.

federal_frame.description: The federal page explaining the program. Always present -- this is what you route to under federal_locator.

jurisdiction_prompt.description: The question to ask, phrased exactly. Note the traps: unemployment keys on where you WORKED, not where you live. Medicaid keys on residence. Getting this wrong misroutes silently.

varies_materially.description: true if eligibility/benefit differs enough by jurisdiction that the federal frame alone would mislead. Forces the prompt before routing.

jurisdictions.description: Only for subtype=own_table. Keyed by USPS state code. Each row carries its own verification.

oneOf.title: journey
oneOf.description: Ordered cross-agency assembly for a life event. Exists because eval case B002 -- widow of a veteran -- has TWO correct answers and picking one is the failure.

trigger.description: The life event, in the words people use.

record_id.description: MUST resolve to an existing record (I2). No inline destinations.

conditional_on.description: Plain-language condition. Descriptive, not a determination.

not_exhaustive_notice.description: REQUIRED. Every journey must state that it is not complete. A checklist that implies completeness is the one way this record type can hurt someone.

oneOf.title: escalation
oneOf.description: Not a website. NOT RETRIEVABLE BY THE ROUTING MODEL (I4) -- matched deterministically upstream, before the model ever sees the query.

patterns.description: Deterministic. Over-trigger on purpose -- a false positive costs one extra screen, a false negative is unacceptable.

contact.description: The number or short code. Rendered as the primary element, not a link.
